operation.description: Real gateway text/function generation frontend. Admission checks live key, workspace, model and provider capabilities. The body cap is 2097152 bytes. A body with inline images may exceed it only when it declares its Content-Length, is at most GATEWAY_MAX_BODY_BYTES_IMAGE_INPUT (default 20971520 bytes), fits this replica's image input buffer (GATEWAY_IMAGE_INPUT_BUFFER_BYTES), arrives without a pause of more than 10 s and within 120 s, and has at most 2097152 bytes outside its images' data URLs. Authentication and the length checks run before any body byte is read. Every refusal is an OpenAI-shaped JSON error, never plain text: 413 payload_too_large, 408 request_timeout, 503 image_input_busy with Retry-After. Unknown fields are 400 invalid_request_error. Usage counters are emitted only when known; Messages message_start input_tokens:0 is a compatibility placeholder, never accounting. Native-only fields and translated-route refusals are described below.

200.description: JSON completion or ordered SSE. Errors after opening a stream are terminal error frames, never fabricated successful termination.

ordered: zero or more content/tool/finish/optional requested usage chunks
one [DONE], or final OpenAI error without [DONE]
x-omg-sse.event_field: absent; message/error classify JSON data, not named events
x-omg-sse.usage: Only with stream_options.include_usage:true; absent or null until all required counters are known.

408.description: A body over 2 MiB stopped arriving: a pause of more than 10 s, under 128 KiB/s on average from its start (after a 128 KiB allowance; a pause counts against it), or more than 180 s in all (invalid_request_error, code request_timeout). Its share of the image input buffer is back; nothing was admitted or sent.

413.description: The body is too large (invalid_request_error, code payload_too_large), always as JSON: a declared Content-Length over GATEWAY_MAX_BODY_BYTES_IMAGE_INPUT or over this replica's whole image input buffer (refused before any body byte is read), a body without a declared length that streams past 2 MiB, or a large body with more than 2 MiB outside its images' data URLs (text cannot ride an image past the text limit).

503.description: Authentication, catalog or accounting storage unavailable, provider configuration unavailable, an unbounded price, or every route cooling down (Retry-After); or, for a declared body over 2 MiB, this replica's image input buffer is full (server_error, code image_input_busy, Retry-After: 1): nothing was read, admitted or sent.

operation.description: Counts the input tokens of a Messages request (#72). Authorized like POST /v1/messages: the workspace and key come from the validated inference key, and the model must be one the key may use now and must serve the messages protocol. Anthropic routes ask Anthropic's counting endpoint with the connection's own credential; every other route returns the gateway estimate. The route is the first one routing would choose; a count never fails over and is not an attempt. Each gateway process bounds counts by key per minute, by provider connection credential per minute (provider-backed counts only) and by its own concurrency pool, separate from generation, of which one key may hold at most 2 counts at once (429 beyond any of them; a count refused for concurrency does not spend the key's minute). A count consults no budget or rate limit and does not consume the key's request-rate allowance. Default root body cap is fixed 2097152 bytes. Unknown fields are 400 invalid_request_error.

parameters.name: anthropic-version
parameters.description: Exactly one occurrence with the literal version 2023-06-01 or 2026-10-21. The count body has no sampling fields and no version-dependent rules, so both versions validate the same body; native Anthropic routes send 2023-06-01 upstream.

x-omg-token-count.description: provider: the route's provider counted the request (Anthropic routes). estimate; method=utf8-bytes-div-4: every other route; the gateway's approximation, the UTF-8 bytes of the system and message text, tool calls and results, and tool names, descriptions and schemas, divided by four and rounded up. It is not the model's tokenizer and can differ from the provider's count in either direction.

GenImageDataUrl.description: An inline image: a base64 data URL with exactly this prefix (no parameters, lowercase scheme) and strict padded base64. Remote http(s) URLs and every other URL are refused (400): the gateway never fetches a caller's URL. Handler semantic validation is additional: the decoded bytes must start with the declared type's signature (PNG, JPEG, RIFF....WEBP, GIF87a/GIF89a), decode to at most 5 MiB (the base64 data at most 6990508 bytes, checked before decoding), and a request carries at most 20 images in all; any violation is 400 naming the field.

GenImageDetail.description: OpenAI's optional detail level, carried to the provider's wire; null is the same as absent.

file.description: Accepted only as null. A part that carries a file is refused with 400 naming messages.content.file, whatever its type.

input_audio.description: Accepted only as null. A part that carries input_audio is refused with 400 naming messages.content.input_audio, whatever its type.

GenChatTextPart.description: A text part. Adjacent text parts join into one text.

file.description: Accepted only as null. A part that carries a file is refused with 400 naming messages.content.file, whatever its type.

input_audio.description: Accepted only as null. A part that carries input_audio is refused with 400 naming messages.content.input_audio, whatever its type.

GenChatImagePart.description: An inline image, on user messages only (400 naming messages.content.image_url elsewhere). The request goes only to routes whose adapter carries images and whose deployment allows image_input; with none left it is refused with 501 unsupported_capability before admission.

GenChatContentParts.description: Content parts of a user message: text and inline images. Parts of type file or input_audio are refused with 400 naming the field.

GenChatTextParts.description: Content parts of a message other than a user message: text only.

GenResponseOutputText.description: Assistant messages only (an echo of earlier output, without annotations); generation-normalization refuses it on other roles.

GenResponseInputImage.description: An inline image, on user messages only (400 naming input.content.input_image elsewhere). A file_id is refused with 400 naming input.content.file_id, an input_file part with 400 naming input.content.input_file. The request goes only to routes whose adapter carries images and whose deployment allows image_input; with none left it is refused with 501 unsupported_capability before admission.
